facts.text: Heaven doesn't get takeaway, so I'm enjoying this. Pass the chips and try not to start an apocalypse.
facts.why: Metatron never says this. His real lines on the Wikiquote page are about being the voice of God and how people need things spelled out.
facts.fix: I hate when people need it spelled out for them!

vibe.verdict: Mooby's, Buddy Christ and the Catholicism WOW campaign are all in, so it feels like Dogma, but the writing is polite where the film is rude.
